title: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.
The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.
At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.
Mission
Technology and a great e-commerce experience lie at the heart of our business. Thousands of restaurants order their supplies through Choco every day. You will own a core part of that experience, from how buyers find products to how they place their orders. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with a practical approach, strong analytical skills and commercial acumen. You understand what makes digital buying experiences work and turn buyer needs and enterprise customer requirements into scalable product improvements that make ordering easier and drive measurable business growth.
What You’ll Do
 - Own a core area of the e-commerce experience across journeys such as product discovery, search, cart, checkout and ordering, shaping its roadmap and driving measurable improvements for buyers and the business.
 - Lead a squad of engineers and a designer from discovery to delivery, shipping valuable features at a high pace and quality.
 - Talk directly with buyers and enterprise customers to understand their needs, test product ideas, and turn insights into improvements to the buying experience.
 - Make data-driven decisions that measurably improve the e-commerce experience and drive business impact, assessing the value of features before and after launch with a focus on conversion rate, average order value, purchase frequency and retention.
 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win and grow enterprise accounts, from large distributors to manufacturers. Turn customer-specific needs into scalable product capabilities, balancing commercial opportunities with value for the broader customer base.
 - Use AI in your daily work and find opportunities to apply it in the buyer experience.
WHAT YOU BRING
 - 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including work with enterprise customers.
 - Experience building and optimizing customer-facing e-commerce journeys such as product discovery, search, catalog, cart, checkout and ordering.
 - A track record of leading a product area end to end, from discovery to delivery, in a scale-up and measurably improving its business results.
 - Sharp product sense and prioritization: you can dive deep into detail while keeping the bigger picture in view.
 - Strong ownership and flexibility: you thrive in a fast-changing environment, are comfortable with ambiguity, and take full responsibility for results.
 - Proven ability to lead through influence, aligning leadership, commercial teams and engineering behind clear decisions.
 - Solid business, technical and UX understanding, and a clear view of how product decisions translate into commercial performance.
 - A user-centric and data-driven approach, combining regular customer contact with strong analytical skills and the ability to work with data yourself.
 - Experience using AI to scale your own work.
 - Excellent communication skills: you move easily from technical discussions with engineers to explaining our product vision in a way anyone understands.
 - Nice to have: experience in the food industry, wholesale or distribution.
WHAT YOU GET
 - Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.
 - Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.
 - Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.
 - In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).
 - Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.
If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.
Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Produktmanager:in
description:
Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte digitale Plattform im Bereich Haus & Wohnen und verbindet Eigentümer mit passenden Fach- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen.
 Als technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen entwickelt die Organisation eine digitale Plattform, über die private Kunden ihre Projekte rund um das Eigenheim anstoßen und passende Anbieter finden können.
 Das Unternehmen bewegt sich an der Schnittstelle von Digital Business, Marketplace, Lead Generation und Consumer Services und arbeitet datengetrieben an der kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Customer Journey und des digitalen Geschäftsmodells.
 Unser Mandant ist ein etabliertes digitales Unternehmen mit einem starken Produkt- und Tech-Umfeld. Für das interne Product-Team suchen wir einen Senior Product Manager mit Schwerpunkt Salesforce & Internal Tools. Dabei geht es nicht um klassisches Projektmanagement, sondern darum, Salesforce als zentrale Plattform strategisch weiterzuentwickeln, zu skalieren und stärker zu automatisieren. 
 Wir suchen dich als Senior Product Manager Salesforce (gn) 
 📍 Deutschlandweit | Hybrid | ca. 1x monatlich vor Ort
 ⏰ unbefristet | Vollzeit
 🎯 Deine Mission: 
 Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Salesforce als zentrale interne Plattform. Dein Ziel: das bestehende System skalierbarer, moderner und stärker automatisiert aufzustellen und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 Dabei verbindest du Product Management, Salesforce-Expertise, technische Architektur und Business-Anforderungen und entwickelst eine klare Produktvision für die Plattform.
 🔎 Dein Verantwortungsbereich: 
 End-to-End-Verantwortung für Salesforce als zentrale interne Produktplattform
 Entwicklung einer klaren Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap für Salesforce und angrenzende Tools
 Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung der Salesforce-Landschaft mit Fokus auf Automatisierung und Effizienz
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales und weiteren Fachbereichen, um Prozesse und Anforderungen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln
 Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in skalierbare Produktlösungen
 Bewertung von Salesforce-Architektur, technischen Möglichkeiten und Grenzen
 Weiterentwicklung einer einheitlichen und skalierbaren Tool- und Datenlandschaft
 Nutzung von Daten und KPIs, um Produktentscheidungen zu treffen und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern
 Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Tech, Data und weiteren internen Stakeholdern
 Auf Senior-Level: Stakeholder für Veränderungen gewinnen, bestehende Lösungen challengen und als fachlicher Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe agieren
 🧩 Das bringst du mit: 
 Ca. 6–10 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management, idealerweise mit internen Tools, B2B-Plattformen oder komplexen Systemlandschaften
 Fundierte Salesforce-Kenntnisse und ein tiefes Verständnis der Salesforce-Plattform
 Salesforce-Zertifizierung bzw. entsprechende nachweisbare Salesforce-Expertise
 Verständnis für Salesforce-Architektur, technische Zusammenhänge und Systemgrenzen
 Erfahrung darin, ein Produkt strategisch und End-to-End zu verantworten
 Starkes Datenverständnis und Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Produktentscheidungen
 Ausgeprägtes Stakeholder Management, insbesondere im Austausch mit Sales und Business-Teams
 Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, auch seniorige Stakeholder fachlich zu challengen
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 🎁 Das erwartet dich: 
 🏡 Flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten deutschlandweit
 🤝 Regelmäßiger persönlicher Austausch vor Ort, ca. 1x monatlich 
 📈 Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, Weiterbildungsbudget und LinkedIn Learning
 🧠 Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit durch das Fürstenberg Institut
 🏋️ Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club
 🚲 JobRad-Leasing
 🚆 Zuschuss bzw. Vergünstigungen für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr
 🍽️ Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsamer Company Day
 📨 Klingt passend? 
 Dann sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – mehr braucht es für den ersten Austausch nicht.

title: Senior Product Manager - PDF Expert
description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of an established European productivity software company.
The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.
Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.
 The Role
 Job Title: Senior Product Manager - PDF Expert
 Location: Berlin, Germany
 Why this role matters
 With over 30 million users globally, our PDF editor is a flagship product poised for its next major evolution: integrating powerful, intuitive AI-driven features. We need a Senior Product Manager to own this critical product area end-to-end, driving high-impact discovery and shipping features that redefine mobile and desktop productivity. Without you, we cannot move fast enough to capture the massive opportunity of AI-powered document workflows across iOS, Mac, and Web.
 What You'll Do
 End-to-end product development for a core PDF product area across iOS, Mac, and Web.
 Lead discovery and identify high-impact product opportunities based on user research and analytics.
 Run a dedicated cross-functional squad of 5 engineers, a designer, and a product analyst.
 Spearhead the strategy, prototyping, and shipping of next-generation AI-powered productivity features.
 Design and execute A/B tests and experimentation frameworks to optimize user funnels and engagement.
 Align engineering, design, and analytics stakeholders to drive initiatives from raw idea to launch.
 What success looks like
 Month 1: You will onboard with your squad, establish your relationship with the Head of Product, and dive deep into our existing mobile UX, user research, and data funnels.
 Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of your squad's backlog, design your first core product experiments, and begin prototyping high-impact AI features or workflow enhancements.
 By end of Q1: You will have successfully shipped your first major feature or experiment to our 30 million users, establishing a clear, data-backed roadmap for the next wave of AI-powered productivity tools.
 Who This Is a Fit For
 Proven B2C mobile-first product manager who has shipped highly engaging consumer apps.
 Experienced leading cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, and data analysts.
 Highly analytical, fluent in A/B testing, user funnels, and product analytics tools.
 Expert in user research, translating deep customer empathy into actionable product requirements.
 Adept at using AI-prototyping, vibe-coding, or productivity tools to automate workflows.
 Thrives in fast-paced, autonomous environments without needing corporate structure or hand-holding.
 What it's like to work here
 At the company, the team balances focused, high-ownership execution with a collaborative, customer-centric culture. The day-to-day work rhythm relies heavily on asynchronous communication to respect focus time and streamline collaboration, keeping meetings intentional. Structured touchpoints like weekly team standups and regular product demos keep everyone aligned on goals. Decision-making is collaborative yet decisive, empowering individual owners to move quickly while utilizing user-research, analytics, and experiment results to resolve disagreements.
 The offer
 Based in Berlin, Germany with a highly collaborative, international team.
 True ownership of a flagship product with a massive scale of 30M+ global users.
 A focus-friendly culture prioritizing asynchronous communication, intentional meetings, and high-ownership execution.
 This probably isn't for you if
 You prefer slow-moving corporate environments, heavy committee-based alignment, and endless meetings.
 Your product experience is exclusively B2B, enterprise, or back-end, rather than consumer-facing (B2C) mobile.
 You prefer executing on pre-defined specs rather than navigating ambiguity, conducting user research, and setting your own roadmap.
 Who are Atlas & Nova?
 I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.
And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.
 How does this work?
 Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.
Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.
 We never post fake jobs
 This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.
Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.
Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.
This job is hosted on whybrilliant.com. Use your LinkedIn profile to register on WhyBrilliant.com and apply for the role directly.

title: PROJECT MANAGER – AI-FIRST DELIVERY (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle
 Wir suchen erfahrene Verstärkung, die Projekte verlässlich ins Ziel bringt und dafür sorgt, dass aus einem guten Plan funktionierende Software wird. Als Project Manager bei Turbine Kreuzberg steuerst du Kundenprojekte vom Business Intent bis zur produktiven Software. Du hältst Scope, Budget und Termine, sorgst dafür, dass das Team immer an dem arbeitet, was für den Kunden gerade am meisten zählt, und setzt AI dabei so selbstverständlich ein wie Backlog und Budgetplan.
Intern führst du integrierte Teams aus Consultants, Engineers und Designer:innen fachlich durch das Projekt, Seite an Seite mit unseren Technical Directors. Beim Kunden sind Fachbereichs- und IT-Verantwortliche dein Gegenüber, intern hast du einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
Du bindest AI-Tooling tief in deinen Arbeitsalltag ein, verstehst, wie Entwicklungsteams heute mit Agentic Engineering liefern, und planst Projekte so, dass diese Geschwindigkeit beim Kunden ankommt – mit menschlicher Verantwortung für Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse. Ganz nach unserem Leitmotiv: »From Intent to Code«.
Deine Aufgaben
 Projektverantwortung: Du planst und steuerst Kundenprojekte end-to-end. Scope, Budget, Termine und Qualität liegen bei dir, von der Beauftragung bis zur Abnahme, im Festpreis genauso wie in Time & Material.
 Anforderungen & Backlog: Du klärst mit dem Kunden Anforderungen und Prioritäten, übersetzt den Business Intent in einen klaren Backlog.
 Projektsteuerung: Du behältst Umfang, Aufwand, Budget und Termine aktiv im Blick und greifst ein, bevor Abweichungen zum Problem werden. Du erkennst Veränderungen frühzeitig, stellst sie transparent vor und schlägst einen passenden Weg vor: Change Request, Nachbeauftragung oder Re-Priorisierung.
 Projektcontrolling: Du verantwortest Budget-Forecast und Abrechnung mit dem Kunden sowie Vorbereitung und Moderation der monatlichen Steering Meetings.
 Stakeholder Management: Du bist im Projektalltag die zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden und managst Erwartungen, Risiken und Eskalationen
 AI-basierte Delivery: Du setzt AI täglich ein, etwa für Anforderungsdokumentation, Meeting-Zusammenfassungen, Status-Reports, Risikoanalysen, Prototypen und Testfälle, und zeigst Team und Kunden, was davon im Projekt wirklich trägt.
 Account-Entwicklung: Du erkennst Potenziale für Folgevorhaben und entwickelst den Account auch strategisch weiter.
 Mitgestalten: Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement in einer AI-first-Organisation aussieht: Prozesse, Templates, Tooling und das Zusammenspiel mit Agentic Engineering.
 Was du mitbringst
 Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder als Product Owner in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mehrere Jahre mit Kundenprojekten in einer Digitalagentur, Technologieberatung oder einem Softwareunternehmen.
 Ownership: Erfahrung mit Projekten mit festem Scope und festen Terminen und ein sicheres Gespür dafür, wann ein Projekt aus dem Ruder zu laufen beginnt.
 Requirements: Die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen so zu formulieren, dass Engineers damit bauen können, und nach Geschäftswert zu priorisieren.
 Tech-Verständnis: Ein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung, von Architekturen und Schnittstellen über Cloud bis zu agiler Lieferung. Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du verstehst, worüber dein Team spricht.
 Zahlenverständnis: Du kalkulierst Budgets, behältst die Marge im Blick und erklärst Forecasts so, dass der Kunde jede Zahl nachvollziehen kann.
 AI-Praxis: KI ist für dich selbstverständlich: Du nutzt Assistenten, Agents und Automatisierungstools täglich, baust dir eigene Workflows und weißt aus Erfahrung, wo AI im Projektalltag trägt und wo nicht.
 Kommunikation: Die Souveränität, Steering Meetings mit Bereichsleitungen genauso zu moderieren wie Refinements und Workshops mit dem Team.
 Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.
 Das erwartet dich bei uns
 Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement bei Turbine aussieht.
 Kurze Wege: Du hast einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
 Langfristige Projekte: Unsere Auftraggeber setzen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit und erwarten strategische Impulse von dir.
 Starke Teams: Du bringst mit erfahrenen Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber Projekte sicher ins Ziel bringst.
 Zwei plus drei: Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel.
 Frischer Wind für deine Ideen: In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege.
 Meerblick statt Bürowand: Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal.
 Wachse über dich hinaus: Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung.
 Fit bleiben, wie du willst: Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club
 Exklusive Vorteile: Über unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bekommst du Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken.
 Über uns
 Turbine Kreuzberg vereint Business Consulting mit Software Engineering. Seit 1997 entwickeln wir digitale Produkte, Architekturen und Systeme für komplexe Geschäftsprozesse und begleiten Unternehmen bei der technologischen Transformation. Unter dem Leitmotiv »From Intent to Code« übersetzen wir geschäftliche Ziele in produktive Software und verantworten deren Umsetzung, Integration und Weiterentwicklung im laufenden Betrieb.
Wir arbeiten konsequent AI-first: Künstliche Intelligenz ist die Grundlage für Zusammenarbeit, Konzeption und Entwicklung. Ziele, fachliche Bewertung und abschließende Entscheidungen bleiben bei uns Menschen. Mit Agentic Engineering erstellen wir früh lauffähige Entwicklungsstände, erproben sie an realen Anforderungen und entwickeln sie iterativ weiter.
Wir sind mehr als 80 Kolleg:innen in Berlin, Faro (Portugal) und remote, inhabergeführt und arbeiten branchenübergreifend für Unternehmen wie HORNBACH, Riese & Müller, Hapag-Lloyd und TURCK.
 C

title: Expert Opportunity - Staff Product Manager ($80/hr, up to $1,600/week)
Chief of Staff
description:
We're building the AI operating system for vets. Our AI agent Emma already runs client communication for clinics in 7 countries, including the largest veterinary groups in the world. With our pre-seed just closed, we're expanding into new products and new markets at the same time. As Chief of Staff, you'll own our expansion into new countries end to end.
 About Vetpal 
 There are more pets than ever, and fewer vets to care for them. Clinics are short on staff, vets spend half their day on admin, and their suicide rate is six times higher than average. We're building the AI operating system for vets. From the first phone call to the invoice, we give vets their time back, with the mission to bring pets, pet owners and their vets closer together.
 The role 
 You work directly with the three founders on whatever matters most for Vetpal at the time. Right now, that's international expansion, and you own it end to end. This is not an assistant role. It's the closest you'll get to building a company without founding one.
 What you'll work on 
 Own our expansion into new countries: pick the markets, build the partnerships, hire country leads and get the first clinics live
 Turn our founder-led sales into a repeatable go-to-market engine
 Build the systems, processes and reporting a fast-growing company needs and doesn't have yet
 Run hiring end to end for key roles
 Prepare board meetings, investor updates and our next fundraise
 Who thrives here 
 You've worked at a Seed to Series A startup and like ambiguity more than structure
 You're analytical, high agency and communicate clearly, in English and German
 You can switch between big-picture strategy and getting the details done in the same hour
 Top-tier consulting or VC is a plus, but startup experience comes first
 You want to build your own company one day, and want to learn how it's really done
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and equity
 Direct access to the founders and full visibility into every decision
 Real ownership over a part of the company from day one
 A small, talent-dense team in Berlin that works with speed and intensity
 Interview process 
 Intro Call
 Deep Dive
 Take-Home Case
 Meet the Team
 References

title: Founders Associate - CTO & COO
description:
About the Company 
 Ground A is a fast-growing German defense technology company developing next-generation counter-drone systems. Our teams in Berlin and Düsseldorf combine engineering, hardware, sensors, and software to build technology for real-world use. As we grow, we need people who can bring structure to complex projects and turn ideas into action.
 About the Role 
 Founders Associate – CTO & COO Technical & Operational Generalist | (m/f/d) Ground A · Berlin (preferred) or Düsseldorf, Germany · Full-time Role Overview We are looking for a curious, hands-on Founders Associate to work directly with our CTO and COO, both co-founders of Ground A. You will support them across technical projects, day-to-day operations, coordination, analysis, and execution. This is a true generalist role: one day you might prepare a technical comparison or coordinate a supplier, the next you might organize a test, update a project tracker, create a presentation, or take care of straightforward operational tasks. No task is too small when it helps the team move faster. You do not need to be a specialist engineer or a programmer. What matters is a solid technical foundation, a structured mindset, a willingness to learn, and the drive to get things done. Practical Details This is a full-time position based in Berlin (preferred) or Düsseldorf. Regular on-site presence is important for working with the team and supporting technical activities. Occasional business travel within Germany may be required. Apply through this job posting with your CV and a short note about a project, internship, or challenge where you took initiative and made things happen.
 Responsibilities 
 Work directly with the CTO and COO to organize priorities, prepare decisions, follow up on action items, and keep projects moving.
 Support technical projects through research, comparisons of technical options, requirements tracking, documentation, and coordination with engineers.
 Help prepare and organize prototype builds, test activities, demonstrations, and field visits — including checklists, materials, schedules, results, and follow-up.
 Coordinate suppliers, orders, deliveries, components, and external partners in close collaboration with Engineering and Operations.
 Take ownership of small cross-functional projects and help improve practical processes, workflows, and internal tools.
 Prepare concise analyses, presentations, project updates, meeting notes, and decision documents for the founders.
 Handle everyday operational tasks when needed — from arranging meetings and travel to updating lists, following up on deliveries, or organizing information.
 Spot bottlenecks, ask the right questions, and proactively solve problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
 Qualifications 
 A technical or analytical background, ideally through studies in engineering, industrial engineering, natural sciences, or a comparable field.
 Recent graduates with relevant internships, working-student experience, or university projects are very welcome; prior full-time experience is not required.
 Experience in consulting, technical project management, startup operations, or an industrial environment is a plus — but not a prerequisite.
 Ability to understand technical topics, communicate with engineers, and turn complex information into clear actions. Programming knowledge is not required.
 Professional English skills; German is a strong advantage.
 Required Skills 
 Ability to understand technical topics, communicate with engineers, and turn complex information into clear actions.
 Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and confidence with everyday productivity tools and presentations.
 Professional English skills.
 Preferred Skills 
 German is a strong advantage.
 Experience in consulting, technical project management, startup operations, or an industrial environment is a plus — but not a prerequisite.
 A versatile doer: happy to switch between analytical work, technical coordination, and practical everyday tasks.
 Curious and fast-learning: you ask good questions and are not afraid of unfamiliar technical topics.
 Reliable and structured: you follow through, keep track of details, and make sure important things get finished.
 Pragmatic and low-ego: you care more about helping the team succeed than about job titles or task size.
 Pay range and compensation package 
 Competitive compensation and potential VSOP participation.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Application Modernization Platform ("AMP") is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer's legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.
AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.
AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.
As the Senior Technical Project Manager, you will work in conjunction with the team's Technical Lead to lead a small Agile team responsible for migrating a customer's legacy Java application to a modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB. The team will use the latest genAI tools and approaches to accelerate the migration process. You will also be responsible for liaising with customers and internal stakeholders, managing concerns and potential resolutions, and guiding the team towards success. The Agile team will be required to be innovative in deriving solutions to unseen challenges, and you will foster a culture of innovation and collaboration within the team.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Germany for our hybrid working model.
### **Position Expectations**
* Agile mindset with an understanding of SCRUM/Kanban processes
* Able to support a project team consisting of onsite, co-located and remote team members
* Be able to proactively identify and remove impediments
* Manage project risks and issues
* Define and refine project team's "Way of Working"
* Streamline communications between the project team and project stakeholders
* Able to manage expectations of project stakeholders, where the majority are leaders within the organization
* Operate in a small, dynamic, fast-growing team, able to be self-sufficient with an ability to have a can-do attitude and make oneself accountable
* Act as a liaison between the customer, project team and the rest of MongoDB (sales, customer success, support, product and engineering) throughout an engagement
* Create plans and priorities for both project delivery and customer resources. Guide customer as well as project team members to a successful business outcome by managing the client relationship and setting and managing customer expectations during implementations
* Establish and lead recurring project status or governance meetings, including preparation of materials and working with customer project manager and key internal and external stakeholders to review key project information and maintain visibility and accountability
* Periodically report, in a concise and actionable manner, project status both internally as well as to the customer and document project progress as per established best practices (meeting minutes, project plan updates, weekly status reports)
* Manage escalations or critical situation
* Assist with scoping of solution and project scope definition
* Adopt a consultative and prescriptive approach that inspires trust and confidence
* Be intrigued by the possibilities of genAI to assist in accelerating the delivery of projects

description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals.  EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence.
